newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP sees improvements on previous qtrs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP sees improvements on previous qtrs.

text.p: Minerals, petroleum and steel giant The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Tuesday it expects a steady improvement on results reported in the period ended February 29 and May 31.

BHP chairman Brian Loton told the annual meeting that the result for the first quarter ending August 31 was down on a year ago, "however, we are seeing steady improvements on the results for the two preceding quarters -- that is, the periods ending on the February 29 and May 31."
BHP reported a 23 percent fall in net profit to A$287 million for its first quarter ending August 31, as a strong Australian dollar exacerbated the impact of weak copper and steel markets.
However, Loton said there were some signs of improvement in demand for some steel products.

"In steel, there are some signs of improvement in demand for structural, reinforcing and flat products, while in petroleum a higher average oil price, improved margins from the Hawaii operaiton and an asset sale contributed to the result," Loton said.
"The results of the Minerals Group were affected by provision of a loss from the sale of the Mali gold assets," he said.
